pairs.subject: conformance-checking
pairs.evidence: scripts/census/check-library-adherence.mjs:110 The adherence checker enforces the presence of a verifiedBy command string for satisfied principles, but never executes it, writes back verified stamps, or demotes failing claims.

techniques.evidence: scripts/census/lib/engine.mjs:204 The scanner filters comment-only lines so prose and documentation about migrations do not trigger false positive violations.

scripts/census/check-library-adherence.mjs:110 The checker checks that verifiedBy is present as a string property in rules.json but never executes it, records proof stamps, or clears stale claims upon failure.

scripts/census/check-library-adherence.mjs:127 Deliberate non-conformance is recorded in rules.json under declined with mandatory substantive rationale and validated against the upstream principle index.
scripts/census/check-library-adherence.mjs:107 The checker accepts self-declared satisfied status by validating string length rather than executing the proof command, mistaking shape for proof.
scripts/census/lib/engine.mjs:265 The engine fails with a structural error when walked files fall below rule.floor, ensuring broken matchers fail loudly rather than reporting false clean passes.
scripts/census/check-library-adherence.mjs:177 The upstream knowledge library principles are pinned by git commit without numbered edition stratification.
scripts/census/run-census.mjs:150 Exit codes map distinct severities: structural engine failures are fatal in all modes, drift is fatal only under --check, and unreviewed items are advisory.
scripts/census/self-test.mjs:93 The runner executes against committed fixtures in __fixtures__/tree/ verifying clean files, exact hit counts, and every fail-loud structural condition.
scripts/census/rules.json:9 Satisfied entries specify inline verification commands (such as grep pipelines), but the checker does not parse head binaries or infer proof rungs.
scripts/census/check-library-adherence.mjs:176 Adherence reports discrete counts with an explicit predicate (upstream repo and commit) rather than computing an uncomparable composite ratio.
scripts/census/rules.json:3 Rules are not required to provide dedicated per-rule fixtures/<RULE-ID>/fail and pass directories; self-tests rely on a single shared fixture tree.

pairs.registryProposal: Distinguish between client-side snapshot verification commands recorded during human audit sessions and active automated claim execution pipelines in claim-write-back.
